io.modelcontextprotocol/serverInfo.title: SMKlog Parcel Shipping Rates
io.modelcontextprotocol/serverInfo.description: Live USPS, UPS, FedEx and DHL Express shipping rates for a parcel sent from a US address — inside the US, or to Canada, the UK, Germany or Australia — described in plain words. No scale, no account and no API key. Also reports how a checkout it prepared is going, tracks shipments bought on SMKlog and serves a monthly US parcel shipping price index.
